description: 10:00 - 10:30: Stang out of EZSV w/ running tool, p/u 3. 5m above EZSV. Balanced cement plug. Theoretical height from 840m to 740m Mixed and pumped 7,7 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 7,8 m3 of drill water, 800 l/min, pumping pressure of 10 bar.
